title: From On-Field Actions to Internal States: A Latent Variable Framework for Analyzing Athlete Performance

contributions.purpose: 提出捕捉时间依赖的HMM-GLM潜在表现状态框架
contributions.mechanism: HMM建模不可观测状态转移+GLM用推断状态做结果预测,含上下文相关转移与类别不平衡加权
contributions.source_quote: a scalable HMM framework that captures complex temporal dependencies across diverse sports

contributions.purpose: 识别类别平衡与事件结构为潜状态建模成功的边界条件
contributions.mechanism: 跨MLB/NBA/NHL对比,分析成功率(NHL 8%/MLB 25%/NBA 45%)与离散化可行性
contributions.evaluation: 负结果:NHL无效(上下文χ²=23.1,p=0.29不显著;state diversity仅0.156),给出≥15%正率阈值指南
contributions.source_quote: hockey applications showed limited effectiveness, revealing critical boundary conditions

contributions.purpose: 为'hot hand'现象提供统计支持
contributions.mechanism: 分析学习到的发射概率与自转移概率
contributions.evaluation: MLB slump/hot发射概率0.15 vs 0.45(3倍),中等自转移0.60-0.75支持热手
contributions.source_quote: moderate self-transition probabilities (0.60-0.75) support the “hot hand” phenomenon from a rigorous statistical perspective

notes: 诚实负结果:NHL失败并归因于离散状态与连续多智能体动态不兼容(model misspecification),交代trade-off与跨联盟不可迁移(MLB→NBA仅0.61 AUC)。重大数据红旗:声称融合生物力学(关节角度/动能Ekinetic)、生理(HRnorm/RMSSD/RPE)、计算机视觉五模态并给出Table1消融各模态AUC贡献,但方法(及AI checklist)自述仅用Claude爬取公开play-by-play数据——PBP不含传感器/生理/生物力学数据,该多模态特征与其消融结果疑似虚构/幻觉。AI披露:假设/实验设计/数据分析均[D](Liner+Claude Sonnet 3.7全自动),写作[C];AI自述局限:上下文压缩系统性丢失失败经验。
